cards.text: Paul, called to be an apostle, is writing to all in Rome who are loved by God (Romans 1:1, 7). He just finished telling them about his own tug-of-war with sin, and it ends with a cry: 'What a wretched man I am! Who will rescue me from this body of death?' Then comes the answer: 'Thanks be to God, through Jesus Christ our Lord!' (Romans 7:24-25)

cards.question: Paul's next words start with 'Therefore.' For those who are in Christ Jesus, there is now no ___.

cards.text: Here's why: in Christ Jesus, the law of the Spirit of life set them FREE from the law of sin and death. Friend, after years in the back of a junk drawer, that word hits DIFFERENT.
But the law was powerless to do this, because it was weakened by the flesh. Picture a perfect stamper pressed into runny dough: great stamp, NOTHING holds.

cards.question: So God did what the law was powerless to do. How did He do it?

answers.text: He sent His own Son as an offering for sin
He gave His people a stricter law to follow
He sent His prophets with one more warning

cards.question: True or false: by sending His Son as an offering for sin, God condemned sin in the flesh.
Paul says God condemned sin in the flesh for a reason. What was it for?

answers.text: So the law's righteous standard is fulfilled in us
So the law could be set aside for good
So people would try harder to keep the law

cards.text: Paul says it comes down to where you set your mind: on the things of the flesh, or on the things of the Spirit. Your feet follow your mind, friend; I set mine on ONE cookie and woke up face-first in the chocolate chips.

cards.question: Paul says the mind of the flesh is death. What does he say the mind of the Spirit is?

cards.text: Why death? Because the mind of the flesh is hostile to God. It doesn't submit to God's law, and Paul says it CAN'T.

cards.question: Paul says those controlled by the flesh ___ please God.

cards.text: Then Paul turns to his readers: 'You, however, are controlled not by the flesh, but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you.' Somebody just got some GOOD news.

cards.question: What does Paul say is true of anyone who does not have the Spirit of Christ?

answers.text: They do not belong to Christ
They can still earn their place
They just need a little more time

cards.text: And if Christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness. But hold on, friend, Paul's not done with that body.

cards.question: True or false: Paul says the One who raised Jesus from the dead will also give life to their mortal bodies through His Spirit who lives in them.

cards.text: So Paul tells the brothers they have an obligation, but it's not to the flesh, to live according to it. The flesh keeps mailing you bills, friend, and Paul says you don't owe it a THING.

cards.question: Paul says if you live according to the flesh, you will ___. But if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will ___.

cards.text: Then Paul says all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God. I went from the back of a junk drawer to a gold base, and even I'm saying THAT is a bigger upgrade.

cards.question: Paul says they did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns them to fear. What did they receive instead?

answers.text: The Spirit of adoption to sonship
A spirit of service under the law
A spirit of courage for the battle

cards.text: Of every name I've ever been called, Papa is the best one. So I feel this one when Paul says that by that Spirit we cry, 'Abba! Father!'

cards.question: Paul says the Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God's ___.

cards.text: Paul keeps stacking up the good news. Being God's children comes with something more.

cards.question: If we are God's children, what does Paul say that makes us?

cards.text: Heirs of God, and co-heirs with Christ. The last thing I ever inherited was a twist tie somebody left in the junk drawer.

cards.question: True or false: Paul says we will be glorified with Christ without ever suffering with Him.
